findings.title: Twin IP-normalize aliases over ipblock.Normalize
findings.description: NormalizeIP and normalizeAuditIP are identical one-liners that only return ipblock.Normalize(raw). server/blocklist.go:17 then wraps NormalizeIP again as clientIP, and AdminHandler.callerIP wraps it a third time. Three names, zero extra policy.
findings.fix: Delete NormalizeIP and normalizeAuditIP. Call ipblock.Normalize at the two remaining sites (audit write + blocklist/admin IP). Inline clientIP/callerIP to that call.

findings.title: Two error-envelope extractors for the same axios shape
findings.description: errorCode/errorStatus live next to auth API types and return ''/0. lib/apiError.ts already exports apiErrorCode/apiErrorStatus for the same envelope (undefined miss). Auth screens use one pair; dialogs use the other. Two public wrappers, one shape.
findings.fix: Delete errorCode and errorStatus. Point auth screens at apiErrorCode/apiErrorStatus (treat undefined like ''/0 at the few === '' / === 0 sites).

findings.title: DecodeOptionalString trim flag is always true
findings.description: All production call sites (links/dto.go, notes/dto.go) pass trim=true. Tests never pass false. The no-trim/preserve-empty path already exists as DecodeOptionalStringRaw. The bool is speculative generality.
findings.fix: Drop the trim parameter; always trim+collapse empty. Keep DecodeOptionalStringRaw for password/hint.
findings.impact: All production call sites (links/dto.go, notes/dto.go) pass trim=true. Tests never pass false. The no-trim/preserve-empty path already exists as DecodeOptionalStringRaw. The bool is speculative generality.

findings.title: isCurrentGeneration is request === current
findings.description: Exported helper with a dedicated charter test that only asserts 1===2 and 2===2. Call sites in probeSession gain no policy, no type, no I/O.
findings.fix: Inline `request === reloadRequest.current` at the two probeSession branches; delete the helper and its === tests.
findings.impact: Exported helper with a dedicated charter test that only asserts 1===2 and 2===2. Call sites in probeSession gain no policy, no type, no I/O.

findings.title: canMailStepUpCode wraps one boolean field
findings.description: Body is `return user.email_2fa_enabled === true`. JSDoc is longer than the function. GoogleRow and PasswordCard immediately bind `const canMailCode = canMailStepUpCode(user)`. Unlike hasSecondFactor, this is not an OR of two fields.
findings.fix: Delete canMailStepUpCode. Read `user.email_2fa_enabled === true` at the two call sites.
findings.impact: Body is `return user.email_2fa_enabled === true`. JSDoc is longer than the function. GoogleRow and PasswordCard immediately bind `const canMailCode = canMailStepUpCode(user)`. Unlike hasSecondFactor, this is not an OR of two fields.

findings.title: auditctx.SetRequest only forwards to Set
findings.description: SetRequest is `Set(r.Context(), kind, id, subject)`. Every production caller already has *http.Request. No extra annotation, locking, or validation.
findings.fix: Delete SetRequest. Replace the 13 handler call sites with auditctx.Set(r.Context(), ...).
findings.impact: SetRequest is `Set(r.Context(), kind, id, subject)`. Every production caller already has *http.Request. No extra annotation, locking, or validation.

findings.title: preview re-exports ports queue sentinels
findings.description: ErrQueueFull and ErrStopped are `= ports.ErrQueueFull/ErrStopped`. Comment says delivery packages should use ports; preview tests keep local names. Two names for the same sentinels.
findings.fix: Delete the aliases. Use ports.ErrQueueFull / ports.ErrStopped inside preview (tests included).
findings.impact: ErrQueueFull and ErrStopped are `= ports.ErrQueueFull/ErrStopped`. Comment says delivery packages should use ports; preview tests keep local names. Two names for the same sentinels.

findings.title: hostOf comment restates the one-liner
